plugins.name: itero
plugins.description: Manage your Itero practice platform from Claude Code — build scenarios from playbooks, design scorecards from training docs, author personas from customer materials, bulk-import users from CSV, assign learning paths and certifications, and manage individual users — plus prep documents for RAG / vector-store ingestion (single-doc and batch consolidation).
